course_outline_concepts: LongAlpaca / LongAlign: 32k–100k instruction data, early generation patterns that paired long-doc QA with short-chat mixing
ProLong (Gao 2024): coherence filter + staged schedule — 20B CPT + 5B SFT to reach 512K on Llama-3-8B
RULER + BABILong + NIAH — synthetic task families and the needle-retrieval lineage from Kamradt 2023 → multi-needle → reasoning-in-a-haystack
Llama-3 long-context: base = 500K RoPE, staged 6-step data mix (8K → 128K over 800B tokens), long-SFT kept at ~0.1%
Qwen 2.5-1M / Qwen 3 + LongRoPE: per-dimension RoPE search via evolutionary strategy + 1M-token inference via DCA with 256K training
The design question: long-context capability is a data + position-encoding + eval co-design problem, not a single knob

sources.what_to_extract: 12K LongAlpaca split (9K long + 3K short); ChatGPT/Claude as teacher on full documents; 3 QA pairs per doc; 40/30/30 papers/books/code mix; LongLoRA coupling; $5K API cost as early-generation floor.

LongAlign-10k Self-Instruct-derived pipeline; Claude-2.1 teacher on 9 source mixtures; 5-question-then-pick-one trick for cross-span coverage; packing with flash_attn_varlen_func and block-diagonal masks; sequence-level loss weighting K/(M·N) formula; sorted batching vs packing; LongBench-Chat 50-sample benchmark.

ShareGPT long-tail filter (≥8K tokens, ≥4 turns, 18K convs); condensed RoPE position-scaling (i/c with c=8 for 16K); real-log provenance vs synthetic; superseded by NTK-aware → YaRN → LongRoPE lineage.
Multi-turn long-context gap beyond single-turn long-doc SFT; 5–10 turns with document referencing; +5–10 LongBench-Chat points when added to single-turn; teacher-context ceiling at ~100K.

Document-coherence thesis; 30B curated long-doc mix (code 40% / books 25% / academic 15% / forum 10% / web 10%); 20B CPT + 5B SFT budget; RoPE base 500K → 128M NTK-aware; code × 4, books × 2, academic × 2, web × 0.5 upweighting; coherence-filter vs concatenated-shorts ablation costing 10+ points on HELMET.

13-task synthetic-generator suite (S-NIAH / MK-NIAH / MV-NIAH / MQ-NIAH / VT / CWE / FWE / QA); needle types (word / 7-digit number / UUID); haystack types (repeated-noise / Paul Graham essays); 500 examples per task per length; effective-context-size metric tied to Llama2-7B@4K = 85.6 baseline; context-vs-complexity orthogonal knobs.

20 bAbI reasoning tasks embedded in PG19 natural prose; lengths 0K–1M standard, up to 50M in paper; hybrid synthetic-natural construction; reasoning-in-a-haystack strictly harder than retrieval-in-a-haystack; contamination resistance via templated facts.

Greg Kamradt Nov 2023 original; Paul Graham filler + 'sandwich at Dolores Park' needle; 2D depth × length heatmap; evolution to multi-needle / multi-key / multi-value / multi-query; NIAH as training signal in ProLong / Qwen / LongRoPE.

21 natural tasks × 6 categories (single-doc QA / multi-doc QA / summ / few-shot / synthetic / code); bilingual EN + ZH; 6K–31K median; LongBench-Chat extension to 100K; complements synthetic RULER/NIAH.

Staged 6-step schedule 8K → 16K → 32K → 64K → 128K across 800B tokens; RoPE base rescaled 10K → 500K; long-SFT kept at ~0.1% to avoid short regression; NIAH 128K ~99% but RULER effective ~64K; raising long-SFT >1% costs ~1 MMLU point.

Fu 2024 5B-token CPT thesis; preserve-cross-domain + upsample-within-domain-by-length rule; SlimPajama reweight with 5× factor for ≥32K docs; breaking domain ratios costs 3–5 MMLU; NTK-aware RoPE 10K → 200M.

Qwen 2.5-1M three-leg pipeline: (1) gradual CPT 32K → 128K → 256K; (2) Qwen-Max-generated synthetic SFT (multi-needle / summarization / RAG-QA / code / FILL-IN); (3) Dual-Chunk Attention for 256K → 1M inference extrapolation; NIAH 1M ~100%, RULER 1M ~85%; training cap at 256K.

Per-dimension λ_i RoPE rescaling found via evolutionary search; population 64, 40 generations, mutation 0.3; fitness = long-ppl + NIAH; two-stage fine-tune (300M stage 1 @ 256K + 600M stage 2 @ 2M); 2M context with < 1B total FT tokens.
PoSE position-skip training; 4K samples with injected δ ~ Uniform[0, target_ctx − 4K] position gap; 4× compute reduction vs full-length training; retrieval-strong but reasoning-weak failure mode.
Long-context embedding evaluation needs its own synthetic-plus-real benchmark design; RoPE extension helps embedders too.
Ultra-long context as application-design problem; context caching; relevance placement matters because attention over 1M is not uniform — a product-side signal that eval can miss.
